title: Holiday Mismatch
description: New retiree Barb joins a Holiday Committee but clashes with long-standing member Kath. When they realize their kids have started dating, they conspire to break up the happy couple.

title: Must Love Christmas
description: Known for her Christmas-themed stories, a renowned romance novelist finds herself snowbound in the charming town of Cranberry Falls. She soon finds herself in an unexpected love triangle with her childhood crush and a determined reporter.

title: Our Holiday Playbook
description: To help her father win their annual flag football game, Lexi convinces Eddie to join the team as her pretend boyfriend in exchange for coaching him through his family baking contest.

title: A Kismet Christmas
description: A children's author reconnects with her hometown, family and teenage crush while confronting a legend that may actually be true.

title: The Nine Lives of Christmas
description: As the Christmas holiday draws near, a veterinary student (Kimberly Sustad) and a stray cat challenge a fireman's (Brandon Routh) commitment to life as a bachelor.

title: Adopting St. Nick
description: After adopting a grandparent from a new retirement community for the holidays, Maren and her daughter Leah cross paths with the program's manager, Reid, and the suspiciously jolliest of residents.

title: Haul Out the Holly
description: Emily comes home to visit her parents, only to discover they're leaving for a trip of their own. While staying at their house for the holidays, Emily meets members of the community who want her to join in the neighborhood's Christmas festivities.

title: Haul Out the Holly: Lit Up
description: Emily and Jared are looking forward to celebrating the holidays together again, this time as a couple. They're also ready to work with members of the community to make this year's Christmas festivities the best yet.

description: The prince's Christmas gift for his mother, a corgi puppy, turns into a disaster when the dog misbehaves constantly. He turns to an American dog trainer for assistance and sparks begin to fly.

title: The Royal Nannies
description: The story follows the continuation of the thematic blend of royal romance and high-stakes mystery. This sequel introduces a broader network of characters dealing with fresh holiday security threats and romance.

title: Pining for Douglas
description: A social media expert named Holly returns home for the holidays and tries to save a massive, historic 60-foot Douglas fir tree from being cut down for a tech company's new headquarters. Along the way, she falls into a romance with the tech company heir.

title: A Danish Christmas
description: Marie helps her family's Copenhagen inn at Christmas when Ryan arrives, and she mistakes him for a travel writer. She curates a tour in search of hygge, and the two find a connection as well.

title: Happy Howlidays
description: Mia, a meticulous webpage editor for the Seattle Tourism Board, finds herself unexpectedly navigating the holidays alone. As the only one working, she has an unforeseen encounter when she meets a stray dog. Unsure how to handle the situation, she crosses paths with Max, a dog shelter owner. Mia agrees to let Max's ailing dog find solace with her newfound companion, in exchange for Max showing her the hidden gems of Seattle.
